decisions.notes: BaridiMap glues a dash to a word inside the Arabic name instead of separating two halves of it, so the dash fold would publish a false separator. The name is corrected to the place the record's own fields name instead. Here the dash sits inside the commune name: the record's own commune_ar reads عين الزانة and its Latin name reads AIN ZANA, one place and not two.
